description: The 89 capability contracts (F00..F88) with separated Founder authority and engineering execution statuses.

authority_classification_rules.APPROVED_REQUIRED_CURRENT: Strictly required for current product convergence release
authority_classification_rules.APPROVED_REQUIRED_FUTURE: Approved capability scheduled for future wave convergence
authority_classification_rules.APPROVED_CONDITIONAL: P3 extensions requiring explicit protected Founder activation secret

capabilities.title: Independent proof authority
capabilities.solution: Gate-level executed assertions, trustworthy raw receipts, source dependency digests and independent owner admission.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: A forged PASS, parent SHA proof or tampered result cannot close an unrelated mandatory gate.

capabilities.title: One release manifest
capabilities.solution: Versioned runtime tuple covering frontend, source commit, database, Edge Functions, worker, scheduled jobs and active generation.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Historical preview and production SHAs do not falsely reconcile.

capabilities.title: Four canonical identities
capabilities.solution: Separate PhysicalItinerary, CommercialOffer, FareObservation and Opportunity with versioned IDs and migration aliases.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Distinct flights do not merge; Saved and Watch retain identity through generation rollover.

capabilities.title: Full TravelIntent
capabilities.solution: Typed trip kind, airport/city scope, outbound/inbound dates, travelers, cabin, stop requirements, baggage and price basis.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: A full UI→API→DB→worker→decision round trip loses no material travel intent field.

capabilities.title: Unknown semantics
capabilities.solution: Use explicit KNOWN, UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE semantics across source, price and travel data.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Unknown stop count, baggage and tax are never silently coerced to zero.

capabilities.title: Provider evidence registry
capabilities.solution: Versioned provider mode, capability, license/terms, source age, parser state, quota and fallback policy.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: HTTP 429/503 or parser failure cannot produce QUALIFIED_EMPTY.

capabilities.title: Coverage certificate
capabilities.solution: Scan proof bound to exact query scope, provider, dates, partition outcomes, generation and time.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Unscanned or partially scanned dates cannot be represented as verified no-fare results.

capabilities.title: Demand-aware worker
capabilities.solution: Union all active eligible Watch scopes before prioritizing under quotas, with bounded fairness, leases and retries.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Watch scopes outside the old first-N candidate slice receive their defined service opportunity.

capabilities.title: Atomic dataset generation
capabilities.solution: Candidate manifest, committed row-count reconciliation, transactional pointer publication and last-known-good fallback.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Crash or partial ingestion cannot expose mixed or false-complete generations.

capabilities.title: Authoritative search
capabilities.solution: Apply eligibility, full-universe filters, sort and count before cursor pagination on the server.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: An eligible offer beyond the first 120, 1,500 or 5,000 rows remains discoverable and correctly ranked.

capabilities.title: Best/lowest truth
capabilities.solution: Arithmetic minimum across fully eligible comparable offers under one PriceScope, with separate unknown/excluded candidate counts.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Different cabins, passenger mixes, return dates or unknown required fees cannot be compared as one exact total.

capabilities.title: Comparable pricing
capabilities.solution: Exact PriceScope cohorts, independent scan epochs, duplicate controls and non-self-comparison. For STRONG historical claims preserve the original threshold: at least 12 independent comparable observations and at least 3 scan epochs, subject to original contract verification.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Multiple records from one scan never manufacture STRONG historical evidence.

capabilities.title: Explainable price label
capabilities.solution: Separate price exceptionality, freshness, confidence, evidence strength, cost uncertainty and journey fit.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Low-evidence prices cannot receive authoritative discount or lowest-ever claims.

capabilities.title: History/Matrix
capabilities.solution: Same-offer time-series by observed_at; departure-date matrix by travel_date; comparable cohort as separate product.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Departure date never masquerades as observation timestamp.

capabilities.title: Opportunity Detail
capabilities.solution: Primary deal card enters Farely's own stable Opportunity Decision Detail; external provider verification is a subsequent CTA.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Card opens the correct durable opportunity with evidence and alternatives.

capabilities.title: Saved lifecycle
capabilities.solution: Persist stable opportunity reference, saved-price snapshot, observed time, current state, expiry, alias migration and account ownership.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Saved survives refresh and correctly shows stale/replaced/invalidated opportunities.

capabilities.title: Watch & notification
capabilities.solution: Qualified Watch transition -> durable outbox -> provider acceptance -> delivery evidence where available -> deduped retry.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No duplicate logical notification episode; no strong price alert based on invalid coverage.

capabilities.title: Security/privacy
capabilities.solution: RLS, grants, RPC access, private credentials, consent, account deletion and bounded public APIs.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Tenant-crossing and privileged RPC abuse tests fail closed.

capabilities.title: Performance & accessibility
capabilities.solution: Actual hydrated browser tests, accessible forms/focus, real Web Vitals where measurable and manual critical journey review.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No critical user-flow accessibility blocker; report measured numbers instead of fabricated performance scores.

capabilities.title: Production release/soak
capabilities.solution: Authorized release process, exact deployment tuple, reversible rollout and at least 24 hours of actual runtime continuity for the historical soak gate.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Synthetic time-series or forged elapsed time cannot satisfy longitudinal proof.

capabilities.title: End-to-end anti-regression
capabilities.solution: Real-module tests, integration, browser journeys, database replay, adversarial faults and preservation proofs.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Critical user journeys survive changes without accepted regression.

capabilities.title: Budget-first Everywhere Explore
capabilities.solution: Origin + maximum budget + flexible travel period -> destination groups from fully covered eligible scopes.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Do not derive minimum price from first-page results or incomplete markets without a coverage warning.

capabilities.title: Flexible Date Matrix
capabilities.solution: Per-date observed minimum with same PriceScope, source age, cohort integrity and coverage status.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Missing cells show UNKNOWN, never 0₫ or invented fare.

capabilities.title: Airport alternatives
capabilities.solution: Nearby airport suggestions with actual transfer time/cost sources or explicitly labeled estimates.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Compare grounded air fare savings against travel inconvenience, not price-only airport swaps.

capabilities.title: Personal value of time
capabilities.solution: Optional disclosed user preferences for duration, stops and inconvenience; keep objective cheapest independent.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Turning preferences off restores transparent price ranking.

capabilities.title: Opportunity rationale
capabilities.solution: Expose sample count, independent epochs, comparable cohort, exclusions, observation age and claim ceiling.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: A user can understand how Farely reached a recommendation.

capabilities.title: Price verification step
capabilities.solution: Clearly distinguish observed price, indicative CTA and provider-repriced quote when available.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Measure reported price match/mismatch, never infer a completed booking from a click.

capabilities.title: Watch setup from intent
capabilities.solution: Prepopulate and explicitly preview exact TravelIntent, departure/return conditions, price, expiry and cadence.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No silent modification of trip dates or traveler composition.

capabilities.title: Saved comparison board
capabilities.solution: Compare 2–4 saved compatible opportunities by verified cost fields, schedule, conditions, age and uncertainties.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No unknown information silently promoted to known.

capabilities.title: Fare movement timeline
capabilities.solution: Observed price history over time, with raw observations and missing-scan gaps.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Chart cannot use travel departure dates as historical observation dates.

capabilities.title: Fare recheck feedback
capabilities.solution: Accept user-reported matched, changed or unavailable price with source and timestamp.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Feedback remains USER_REPORTED until independently verified.

capabilities.title: Decision modes
capabilities.solution: Separate Cheapest Observed, Convenient, Budget Fit and Lower Risk rankings.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Users can inspect ranking reasons and return to objective price sort.

capabilities.title: Discovery empty/degraded recovery
capabilities.solution: Separate provider unavailable, no scan, partial coverage, genuinely no eligible offer and stale state.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Provider 503 does not show generic "không tìm thấy vé".

capabilities.title: Vietnamese-first travel language
capabilities.solution: Natural Vietnamese UI for price units, observed-age, local date/time, baggage, airline and fare conditions.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Real user tasks show comprehension of data limitations.

capabilities.title: Digest and noise control
capabilities.solution: Instant/daily/weekly cadence, quiet hours, per-episode suppression, unsubscribe and delivery health.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No duplicate notifications and measurable alert burden.

capabilities.title: Data provenance UI
capabilities.solution: Compact source/age/evidence badges with detailed provenance on demand.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Users distinguish observed vs verified vs unavailable.

capabilities.title: Trust-calibrated Buy/Wait guidance
capabilities.solution: Longitudinal train/test split, forecast calibration, naive-baseline comparison and confidence limits.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Return insufficient_data until real out-of-sample evidence supports stronger guidance.

capabilities.title: Price anomaly detection
capabilities.solution: Robust seasonal/change-point analysis with measured precision@K and false-deal rate.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Never make strong anomaly claims on insufficient sample.

capabilities.title: Personalized travel feed
capabilities.solution: Explicit preference opt-in, privacy controls and controlled retention/saved-outcome evaluation.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No sensitive inference or covert profiling.

capabilities.title: Weekend escape templates
capabilities.solution: Schedule-aware weekends, local holidays, departure/arrival time and known fare coverage.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Templates must be possible and based on observed supporting data.

capabilities.title: Group/family fare planning
capabilities.solution: Correct traveler ages, baggage, seats and total-party fare scope.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Single-adult price cannot be shown as family total.

capabilities.title: Multi-city itinerary
capabilities.solution: Explicit multi-slice TravelIntent and provider-supported itinerary coherence.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No joining unrelated one-way tickets into a fictitious single purchasable offer.

capabilities.title: Deal curation and editorial collections
capabilities.solution: Human-reviewable collections based on evidence, freshness and expiry.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No fabricated scarcity or unsupported featured discount.

capabilities.title: Direct/affiliate provider comparison
capabilities.solution: Compare actual provider quote basis, refresh state, link class, partner rights and disclosures.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Commercial ranking does not override undisclosed objective cheapest result.

capabilities.title: Anonymous -> account continuity
capabilities.solution: Explicit consent-based guest-to-account Saved/Watch transfer with identity isolation.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No silent cross-account merge.

capabilities.title: Sharing, referrals and viral loops
capabilities.solution: Public links without personal information, bounded abuse controls and measurable acquisition outcomes.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No PII leaks or misleading stale deal shares.

capabilities.title: Explore by total trip budget
capabilities.solution: Include hotel and ground components only with source-supported data; preserve uncertainty.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No exact trip-total claim with unknown material costs.

capabilities.title: Partner integrations
capabilities.solution: Provider capability, live repricing, commercial permission, reliability and unit-economics evaluation.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No source enabled commercially without supporting rights and economics.

capabilities.title: Mobile-first PWA and push
capabilities.solution: Offline-safe experience, permission/consent, cache certainty protection and Watch-driven notification value.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Offline observed fares cannot appear as freshly available deals.

capabilities.title: AI travel copilot
capabilities.solution: LLM uses typed verified tools and deterministic price computation. No hallucinated prices, routes or available seats.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Empirical usefulness and factual grounding must beat simpler workflows before public activation.

capabilities.title: Historical fare forecasting
capabilities.solution: Longitudinal unbiased observation data and rolling-horizon backtesting.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No forecasting launch without evidence of calibration and practical value.

capabilities.title: Subscription/premium Watch
capabilities.solution: Proven recurring alert value, compliant billing, cancellation, support and consent.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No paid launch without commercial and product authorization.

capabilities.title: Full ticket checkout
capabilities.solution: Licensed issuing/fulfillment, booking provider integration, payment, refunds and support.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No direct checkout launch without authorized supplier and operational responsibility.

capabilities.title: B2B Fare Intelligence API
capabilities.solution: Explicit source redistribution rights, commercial quota, billing and quality SLA.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No B2B data resale based merely on the license of a scraper library.

capabilities.title: Credit-card / promotion optimization
capabilities.solution: Actual provider payable price + accurate card/promotion terms and effective periods.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No invented savings or irrelevant cashback catalog.

capabilities.title: International language and market expansion
capabilities.solution: Provider country rights, currency handling, localized policy and operational support.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No market release without supported data and service model.

capabilities.title: Authenticated Watch scoping
capabilities.solution: Remote tenant-owned Watch records are authoritative for signed-in users; guest cache must be isolated.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Account A logout -> Account B login shows no A Watch/email.

capabilities.title: Watch mutation acknowledgement
capabilities.solution: Server-authoritative idempotent pause/resume/delete and UI rollback.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: 403/500/offline cannot result in confirmed success UI.

capabilities.title: Typed WatchDateScope
capabilities.solution: Distinct outboundDateFrom/To, returnDateFrom/To, duration and any-date monitoring horizon.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Return date never becomes outbound window end.

capabilities.title: No invented observation time
capabilities.solution: Separate provider_observed_at, fetched_at and processed_at; preserve unknown provider time.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Unknown timestamp cannot be converted into "just observed".

capabilities.title: Provider date provenance
capabilities.solution: Dates must originate from supported provider data and be validated.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Request date alone cannot certify physical flight date.

capabilities.title: One-way/roundtrip support boundary
capabilities.solution: Typed capability matrix for each provider.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: One-way request never silently becomes round-trip.

capabilities.title: Immutable response coverage identity
capabilities.solution: Each response includes scope fingerprint, source mode, coverage IDs and generation.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: A partial result page cannot claim full-market coverage.

capabilities.title: Watch visibility & truthful SLA
capabilities.solution: Show last checked, actual scan health, expected next evaluation and degraded status.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Stalled Watch cannot appear recently evaluated.

capabilities.title: Notification observed-at fidelity
capabilities.solution: Every price-specific alert references actual source observation and time.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Missing observation ID prevents a strong fare notification.

capabilities.title: Source mode quarantine
capabilities.solution: Separate OBSERVED_SCRAPE, CACHED_PRICE, LIVE_SEARCH and REPRICED modes.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Cached fares cannot be labeled purchasable live inventory.

capabilities.title: Currency and price scope integrity
capabilities.solution: Persist ISO currency, traveler mix, price unit and FX source/time when converted.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No cross-currency cheapest claim without suitable conversion evidence.

capabilities.title: Baggage/fare-rule uncertainty
capabilities.solution: Known mandatory fees, optional fees, estimates and unknowns are separate.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Unknown baggage is not free or included.

capabilities.title: Airport and local datetime correctness
capabilities.solution: IATA airport vs metro scope, timezone-aware flight instants and overnight connections.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Cross-timezone or same-city airport alternatives are evaluated correctly.

capabilities.title: Canonical client data adapters
capabilities.solution: Typed adapters preserve null/unknown instead of Number(x)||0 coercion.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Unknown values survive API -> UI -> Saved -> Watch -> notification.

capabilities.title: Watch source quorum and parser mode
capabilities.solution: Monitor parser/partition outcomes before certifying successful empty search.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Zero rows + parse failure = provider failure, not verified empty.

capabilities.title: Demand scheduler guarantees
capabilities.solution: Full active Watch demand union precedes candidate limit and quota selection.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Watch route beyond first-N tracked routes is not silently starved.

capabilities.title: Exact vs indicative CTA gate
capabilities.solution: Use exact deep links only when validated and allowed; generic/expired links disclose limits.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Generic search link cannot be labeled exact offer purchase.

capabilities.title: Browser-cache staleness ceiling
capabilities.solution: Cache entries carry observed timestamp, fetched timestamp, source and TTL.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: A 7-day-old cache is never shown as a fresh fare.

capabilities.title: Cross-user analytics and privacy
capabilities.solution: Session/auth-bound pseudonymous analytics and logout cleanup.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No Watch/email leakage through browser caches or queued events.

capabilities.title: Verification reconciliation feedback
capabilities.solution: Capture observed price vs user/provider recheck result with valid denominators.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No booking or price-match success inferred from mere external clicks.

capabilities.title: Transparent partnership ranking
capabilities.solution: Separate editorial/affiliate promotion from objective cheapest ranking.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Changing referral revenue cannot silently change price sort.

capabilities.title: Secret and quota hygiene
capabilities.solution: Server-only secrets, redacted logs, safe provider quotas, rate limits, circuit breakers.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No secret leaks; quota 429 handled without false data truth.

capabilities.title: Synthetic-proof adversary
capabilities.solution: Gate-bound assertions, source hashes, real elapsed receipts and mutation detection.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Forged timestamps or parent SHA cannot prove new runtime behavior.

capabilities.title: Visual intent task tests
capabilities.solution: Actual tasks: find, compare, save, Watch, verify and understand data status.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Measurable task success/confusion; screenshots alone are insufficient.

capabilities.title: Compact evidence-led cards
capabilities.solution: Price basis, observed age, source class and uncertainty in progressive UI.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Users understand observed fare may change before booking.

capabilities.title: PWA operational safeguards
capabilities.solution: Offline-safe caching, secret safety and stale-data warnings.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Offline state cannot elevate cached fare certainty.

capabilities.title: Deal invalidation and lifecycle
capabilities.solution: Stable historical opportunity, expired/replaced states and compatible alternatives.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Saved opportunity does not disappear or point to a different physical flight.

capabilities.title: End-to-end after schema upgrade
capabilities.solution: Forward-compatible DB migrations and Edge/function signature checks.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Old/new consumer compatibility proven in isolated integration.

capabilities.title: Real notification receipt chain
capabilities.solution: Watch match -> durable outbox -> provider acceptance -> signed delivery event where supported.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Provider accepted is not delivered; logical episodes deduplicated.

capabilities.title: Provider source rights registry
capabilities.solution: Track source scraping terms, display, caching, redistribution and affiliate rights.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No premium/B2B redistribution without actual rights.

capabilities.title: Vietnam-specific travel UX
capabilities.solution: Vietnamese airport names, VND, baggage options, holidays and local transport context.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: Localized real-data user tasks.

capabilities.title: Intent-based itinerary group planner
capabilities.solution: Group/family/multi-leg planning only with compatible trip and price units.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No one-person price promoted to total family fare.

capabilities.title: Data economics optimizer
capabilities.solution: Track cost per scanned scope, eligible offer, verified opportunity and useful Watch event.
capabilities.acceptance_criteria: No scan expansion without measured marginal value.
